entries.name: Overall composition
entries.condition: still vs reference_a composition metrics + visual comparison of layout
entries.evidence: Horizon 0.247 vs 0.250 and aircraft width 0.228 vs 0.232 match, but water area is 0.54 vs 0.31, bridge end lands at [0.668,0.376] vs [0.735,0.325], aircraft bbox IoU 0.76, and the reference's large foreground island in A5-C8 is replaced by open water and a straight pier in A6-C6.
entries.defect: Land/water balance and bridge heading are wrong: the reference is land-heavy in the left half and the bridge runs to the upper-right; here the left half is empty turquoise water.
entries.fix: Move the camera ~120 m left/forward and yaw +6 deg, or extend the left island so its sand reaches A5-B8 and rotate the bridge alignment ~10 deg clockwise so its far end lands near [0.735,0.325].

entries.name: Aircraft silhouette
entries.condition: aircraft outline against water at native res and in crops/aircraft.png
entries.evidence: Wing span:chord ratio is about 12:1 (span 640 px, chord 55 px in crop_aircraft) versus ~9:1 for a DHC-2 style floatplane; the vertical fin at G6 is a 12 px sliver and no horizontal stabiliser or aft fuselage is visible.
entries.defect: Glider-like over-long, narrow wing and vestigial tail make the silhouette read as a toy, not a bush floatplane.
entries.fix: Widen the wing chord ~30%, add ~3 deg dihedral, enlarge the fin/rudder and horizontal stabiliser so they clear the wing trailing edge from this pitch.

entries.name: Aircraft geometry
entries.condition: zoom_cockpit.png (3x) and zoom_floats.png: struts, floats, prop, cowl
entries.evidence: Wing struts are 1 px black lines that descend from the wing directly to the float spreader area rather than to the lower fuselage; the float rigging is a set of 1 px wires with no thickness; the prop is a translucent flat disc with a chrome hub.
entries.defect: Strut routing is wrong and all bracing is paper-thin single-pixel geometry.
entries.fix: Route the two wing struts to fuselage hardpoints at the cabin floor line, give struts/float legs an airfoil cross-section at least 3 px wide at this distance, and add the float spreader bars as solid bars.

entries.name: Aircraft scale
entries.condition: projected aircraft width fraction vs reference and size relative to 25 m boats/bridge
entries.evidence: Width 0.228 vs 0.232 and centroid displacement 0.026; the aircraft is ~14 boat lengths wide relative to the speedboat at F8, which is plausible at 380 m altitude.
entries.defect: Slightly high in frame (centroid y 0.715 vs 0.74), cutting the tail area closer to the horizon band.
entries.fix: Lower the aircraft 25 px in the fixed camera view (pitch camera +1 deg).

entries.name: Aircraft materials
entries.condition: white wing and yellow fuselage shading at 2.4x (crops/aircraft.png)
entries.evidence: The white upper wing is a uniform 235-245 value with no roughness variation, panel seams or dirt; the fuselage top shows a single soft highlight; yellow is [220,206,99] vs reference [239,199,90], dE 11.7 (greener, less saturated).
entries.defect: Uniform roughness across the whole wing and cabin, no micro-detail or specular breakup.
entries.fix: Add a roughness/AO map with rivet lines, walkway strip and oil streak behind the cowl; shift base yellow toward [239,199,90].

entries.name: Cockpit and glass
entries.condition: windshield and side windows at 3x zoom
entries.evidence: Windshield shows two dark blue-grey panes with yellow frames and a hint of seat/interior behind, plus a faint sky reflection; the panes are not opaque black and do not flicker across clip frames 0/10/20/29.
entries.defect: Glass is dark and low-contrast so the pilot/interior is barely legible and there is no fresnel brightening at glancing angle.
entries.fix: Increase glass transmission (alpha ~0.35) and add a fresnel-weighted environment reflection so the top edge of the windshield catches sky.

entries.name: Buildings and skyline
entries.condition: skyline crop at 4x (zoom_skyline.png) and left city (A3-B3)
entries.evidence: About 25 distinct towers with varied heights and roof forms, a container port with coloured stacks at D3; behind the towers the sprawl is a uniform pale green plane [200,215,180] speckled with 1 px dots out to the horizon.
entries.defect: Tower facades are flat saturated blue/grey blocks with no window grid or floor lines at this distance, and the hinterland reads as a flat noise texture.
entries.fix: Add a 2-3 storey-per-texel window/floor detail texture on towers and replace the sprawl plane with low-rise block geometry or a shaded impostor texture with roads.

entries.name: Terrain and coastlines
entries.condition: island beach edge, wet sand gradient, foam line at native res (crop_beach.png)
entries.evidence: Sand measures [212,203,181] vs reference [184,167,148] (dE 12.9), almost white; the sand-to-canopy boundary at C6-D7 is a hard line with no undergrowth transition; the foam edge at E7-E8 has visible stair steps; a thin turquoise shallow band exists.
entries.defect: Over-bright sand and a hard vegetation edge make the island look like a cut-out on a texture.
entries.fix: Lower sand albedo ~15%, add a 5-10 m scrub/grass transition and a wet-sand darkening band under the foam.

entries.name: Water color and depth
entries.condition: water colour near/far vs reference, depth-based gradients
entries.evidence: waterNear [59,149,177] vs ref [80,148,171] dE 4.7, waterFar dE 4.6; turquoise shallows with darker seagrass patches around the island and a lagoon gradient at D5-E6.
entries.defect: Deep water in E8-H8 has no visible wave shape or sun sparkle so it reads as a smooth gradient plane; far water E3-F3 shows horizontal dark bands.
entries.fix: Add a normal-mapped wave layer with sun glitter and remove/soften the far-field horizontal band artefacts.

entries.name: Water reflections
entries.condition: look for reflections of bridge towers, clouds and aircraft in water
entries.evidence: No discernible reflection of the two bridge towers under E4 or of the large cloud in A1-D2 on the water; reflection pass runs 69 calls but its contribution is not visible at this pitch.
entries.defect: Reflections are effectively absent so the water lacks anchoring to the sky and structures.
entries.fix: Increase reflection weight at this grazing angle (fresnel) and ensure towers/clouds are included in the reflection render list.

entries.name: Boat wakes and water interaction
entries.condition: wake shape, width, fade and boat position (zoom_boat.png, zoom_boat2.png)
entries.evidence: Both wakes are straight streaks of constant width (~4 px) with no V divergence or fade; at H6 the wake continues ~50 px ahead of the boat's bow.
entries.defect: Wake geometry is a chalk line that leads the boat, which a player will see instantly.
entries.fix: Anchor the wake origin at the transom, build it as a Kelvin V (19.5 deg) with foam that widens and fades along its length.

entries.name: Vegetation
entries.condition: canopy shapes and variety at native res
entries.evidence: Canopies are overlapping spheres of 6-8 near-identical radii with a dark outline, 'lollipop' style; no palms visible on the main island except 3-4 tiny sprites on the beach; distant islands use the same dark-green blob texture.
entries.defect: Clone-tree spheres repeated hundreds of times without shape variation.
entries.fix: Use 4-6 tree species with distinct silhouettes (palm, sea grape, casuarina), vary scale 0.7-1.4 and add sub-canopy undergrowth.

entries.name: Bridge and infrastructure accuracy
entries.condition: bridge deck, towers, piers and shadow (zoom_deck.png 7x, zoom_bridge.png)
entries.evidence: Two H-towers with fan cables, a raised main span, cars on deck, evenly spaced pier stubs under the approach; the deck top is [235,235,235] white and the piers are 2-3 px stubs that are hard to see against the water; the pier in A6-C6 is a featureless white bar.
entries.defect: Deck brightness reads as white concrete not asphalt, and approach piers are barely visible so the deck seems to hover.
entries.fix: Darken the roadway to ~[90,90,90] with lane markings, lengthen piers to visibly touch the water with a contact shadow, add railings on the pier.

entries.name: Cloud volume
entries.condition: cloud edges, base and internal shading (crop_clouds.png)
entries.evidence: The main cloud has a flat, jagged base line at y~150 px with stair-stepped alpha edges, a uniform grey underside and no internal light/shadow gradient; a detached round puff sits at C2.
entries.defect: Clouds read as flat sprites with aliased edges rather than volumes.
entries.fix: Render clouds as volumetric/raymarched or layered impostors with soft alpha, a lit top and shadowed base gradient.

entries.name: Atmospheric perspective
entries.condition: sky gradient, horizon haze, distant land fade (vertical profile at x=1300)
entries.evidence: Sky at row 2-3 is [196-211,203-213,209-216] grey; skyTop dE 25.9 vs reference; the sky-to-sea transition at y=273-276 is a 3 px step from [211,213,216] to [199,203,209]; the far sprawl fades correctly.
entries.defect: Over-hazed grey upper sky and a hard 3 px horizon step.
entries.fix: Reduce haze density above 10 deg elevation to keep blue [55,134,180] at the top, and blend the horizon over 12-20 px.

entries.name: Sunlight and exposure
entries.condition: highlight clipping on sand, deck, cloud tops
entries.evidence: Sand and bridge deck exceed 210 on all channels; cloud tops clip to 245; the aircraft and vegetation are correctly exposed.
entries.defect: Bright surfaces clip so the frame loses texture in the highlights.
entries.fix: Lower exposure by ~0.3 EV and apply a filmic tonemap shoulder.

entries.name: Shadow quality
entries.condition: tree shadows on sand, bridge shadow on water
entries.evidence: Soft dark blobs beside trees on the sand at C7-D7 exist; no bridge shadow visible on the water; cascade counters show 3 cascades.
entries.defect: Bridge and pier shadows missing on water.
entries.fix: Enable water to receive shadows from the cascade maps.

entries.name: Reflections and specular response
entries.condition: sun glitter on water and specular on the aircraft
entries.evidence: No sun sparkle anywhere on the water; the aircraft fuselage has a single broad highlight and the white wing none.
entries.defect: No specular response on water; aircraft specular is uniform.
entries.fix: Add a GGX sun highlight on the water normal map and vary aircraft roughness by material.

entries.name: Color grading
entries.evidence: Sky is desaturated grey-blue vs the reference's saturated blue; water and vegetation match within dE 6.1; sand and yellow drift warm/light.
entries.defect: Grey sky pulls the frame toward a washed-out look.
entries.fix: Grade the sky with +20% saturation and cooler top.

entries.name: Motion and temporal stability
entries.evidence: Mean consecutive-frame |diff| 3.4-4.1 with camera fixed; edge diffs at canopy and skyline edges are sub-pixel motion, no LOD pops or texture swaps seen; the aircraft bank angle visibly changes between frames 0, 10 and 20.
entries.defect: Canopy edges have 1 px crawl frame to frame and the aircraft rolls noticeably during a 1 s clip.
entries.fix: Enable TAA or MSAA on foliage edges; damp the roll oscillation.

entries.name: Flight physics and camera behavior
entries.condition: aircraft attitude and telemetry across the clip
entries.evidence: V/S swings +350 to -250 fpm over 30 frames while airspeed stays 102-104 kt; bank changes about 8 deg between frames 0 and 10 in a fixed camera.
entries.defect: Visible pitch/roll oscillation within one second suggests under-damped control or autopilot.
entries.fix: Increase pitch and roll damping and low-pass the V/S readout.

entries.name: Object density and world believability
entries.condition: count of boats, cars, marina, port, birds, traffic
entries.evidence: Two speedboats with wakes, cars on the isthmus and bridge, a marina at A8-B8, a container port at D3; the open water in E8-H8 and A4-C5 is otherwise empty.
entries.defect: Large empty water areas and no birds/aircraft/ferry traffic.
entries.fix: Add 3-5 more vessels of varied types and gulls near the beach.

entries.name: Detail consistency across distance
entries.condition: distant islands and city vs near island
entries.evidence: Near island has individual trees; distant islands at E3-G3 are flat dark-green shapes with a sand rim and no tree silhouettes.
entries.fix: Add a tree-line impostor LOD for distant islands.

entries.name: Lack of repetition
entries.evidence: Identical sphere canopies; the two parallel islands in D3-E3 are near-identical elongated shapes.
entries.defect: Clone canopy and clone island shapes.
entries.fix: Vary tree species and island outlines.

entries.name: Lack of visual artifacts
entries.evidence: Stair-stepped cloud alpha edges; isolated single-pixel red/green dots in the water at D4 and H6 (sub-pixel buoys/boats); wake ahead of boat at H6; horizontal dark banding across far water at E3-F3.
entries.defect: Multiple small artefacts visible at 100% zoom.
entries.fix: Fade sub-pixel objects, soften cloud alpha, fix wake anchoring and far-water banding.

entries.name: UI readability
entries.evidence: Six small semi-transparent boxes with 14-18 px text; readable; the build string at A8 is 9 px and hard to read; HUD does not cover the aircraft or bridge.
entries.defect: Build stamp is too small and the HUD overlaps the cloud at A1-A2.
entries.fix: Increase build text to 12 px and shift the left column down 20 px.

entries.name: FPS and frame-time stability
entries.evidence: Clip frame times 6.3-11.2 ms (steady), 271 calls, 1.04 M triangles; still capture shows p99 66.5 ms and one long task; onePercentLow 15 fps.
entries.defect: A 66 ms spike on the warm-up frame.
entries.fix: Precompile shaders and warm textures before the capture window.
